ride_progress_journals_timeline.name: ride_progress_journals_timeline
ride_progress_journals_timeline.value: typeof("ride_progress_journals"."started_at_ms") = 'integer' AND "ride_progress_journals"."started_at_ms" BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991 AND typeof("ride_progress_journals"."last_ended_at_ms") = 'integer' AND "ride_progress_journals"."last_ended_at_ms" BETWEEN "ride_progress_journals"."started_at_ms" AND 9007199254740991 AND "ride_progress_journals"."last_reward_day" = date("ride_progress_journals"."last_ended_at_ms" / 1000, 'unixepoch')

ride_progress_ranges_ticks.name: ride_progress_ranges_ticks
ride_progress_ranges_ticks.value: typeof("ride_progress_ranges"."start_tick") = 'integer' AND "ride_progress_ranges"."start_tick" BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991 AND typeof("ride_progress_ranges"."end_tick") = 'integer' AND "ride_progress_ranges"."end_tick" BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991 AND "ride_progress_ranges"."end_tick" > "ride_progress_ranges"."start_tick"

strava_connection_state.name: strava_connection_state
strava_connection_state.value: ("strava_connections"."status" = 'pending' AND "strava_connections"."handoff_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "strava_connections"."binding_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "strava_connections"."confirm_by" IS NOT NULL) OR ("strava_connections"."status" IN ('connected', 'revocation_pending') AND "strava_connections"."handoff_hash" IS NULL AND "strava_connections"."binding_hash" IS NULL AND "strava_connections"."confirm_by" IS NULL)

strava_delivery_authority_state.name: strava_delivery_authority_state
strava_delivery_authority_state.value: COALESCE(CASE json_extract(authority,'$.kind') WHEN 'consented' THEN json_type(authority,'$.consentedAtMs') = 'integer' WHEN 'stopped' THEN json_type(authority,'$.stoppedAtMs') = 'integer' AND json_extract(authority,'$.reason') IN ('disconnect','credentials','policy') END,0)

strava_delivery_progress_state.name: strava_delivery_progress_state
strava_delivery_progress_state.value: COALESCE(CASE json_extract(progress,'$.kind') WHEN 'queued' THEN json_type(progress,'$.notBeforeMs') = 'integer' WHEN 'preparing' THEN json_type(progress,'$.owner') = 'text' AND json_type(progress,'$.leaseUntilMs') = 'integer' WHEN 'submitting' THEN json_type(progress,'$.attemptId') = 'text' AND json_type(progress,'$.startedAtMs') = 'integer' AND json_type(progress,'$.leaseUntilMs') = 'integer' WHEN 'submission_unknown' THEN json_type(progress,'$.attemptId') = 'text' AND json_extract(progress,'$.reason') IN ('response_lost','crash','protocol') WHEN 'processing' THEN json_type(progress,'$.nextPollAtMs') = 'integer' AND json_extract(progress,'$.issue') IN ('none','authorization','rate_limit','network','protocol') WHEN 'delivered' THEN json_type(progress,'$.activityId') = 'text' AND json_type(progress,'$.confirmedAtMs') = 'integer' WHEN 'submission_rejected' THEN json_extract(progress,'$.reason') IN ('authorization','rate_limit','file','provider') WHEN 'processing_rejected' THEN json_extract(progress,'$.reason') = 'provider_error' END,0)

strava_delivery_receipt.name: strava_delivery_receipt
strava_delivery_receipt.value: CASE WHEN json_extract(progress,'$.kind') IN ('processing','delivered','processing_rejected') THEN COALESCE(json_type(progress,'$.receipt.uploadId') = 'text' AND json_type(progress,'$.receipt.externalId') = 'text',0) ELSE 1 END

volts_grant_operators_provenance.name: volts_grant_operators_provenance
volts_grant_operators_provenance.value: ("volts_grant_operators"."provenance" = 'recorded' AND "volts_grant_operators"."operator_user_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("volts_grant_operators"."provenance" = 'unknown_before_audit' AND "volts_grant_operators"."operator_user_id" IS NULL)

volts_ledger_ride_reward.name: volts_ledger_ride_reward
volts_ledger_ride_reward.value: "volts_ledger"."reason" <> 'ride_reward' OR ("volts_ledger"."reward_day" IS NOT NULL AND "volts_ledger"."start_tick" IS NOT NULL AND "volts_ledger"."end_tick" IS NOT NULL AND "volts_ledger"."candidate_volts" IS NOT NULL AND "volts_ledger"."cumulative_work_volts" IS NOT NULL AND "volts_ledger"."cumulative_climb_volts" IS NOT NULL AND "volts_ledger"."cumulative_facts_json" IS NOT NULL AND "volts_ledger"."delta_volts" >= 0)

volts_ledger_purchase.name: volts_ledger_purchase
volts_ledger_purchase.value: "volts_ledger"."reason" <> 'purchase' OR ("volts_ledger"."reward_day" IS NULL AND "volts_ledger"."start_tick" IS NULL AND "volts_ledger"."end_tick" IS NULL AND "volts_ledger"."candidate_volts" IS NULL AND "volts_ledger"."cumulative_work_volts" IS NULL AND "volts_ledger"."cumulative_climb_volts" IS NULL AND "volts_ledger"."cumulative_facts_json" IS NULL AND "volts_ledger"."delta_volts" < 0)

volts_ledger_operator_grant.name: volts_ledger_operator_grant
volts_ledger_operator_grant.value: "volts_ledger"."reason" <> 'operator_grant' OR ("volts_ledger"."reward_day" IS NULL AND "volts_ledger"."start_tick" IS NULL AND "volts_ledger"."end_tick" IS NULL AND "volts_ledger"."candidate_volts" IS NULL AND "volts_ledger"."cumulative_work_volts" IS NULL AND "volts_ledger"."cumulative_climb_volts" IS NULL AND "volts_ledger"."cumulative_facts_json" IS NULL AND "volts_ledger"."delta_volts" > 0)

volts_ledger_ticks.name: volts_ledger_ticks
volts_ledger_ticks.value: ("volts_ledger"."start_tick" IS NULL AND "volts_ledger"."end_tick" IS NULL) OR (typeof("volts_ledger"."start_tick") = 'integer' AND "volts_ledger"."start_tick" BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991 AND typeof("volts_ledger"."end_tick") = 'integer' AND "volts_ledger"."end_tick" BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991 AND "volts_ledger"."end_tick" > "volts_ledger"."start_tick")

volts_ledger_candidate_volts.name: volts_ledger_candidate_volts
volts_ledger_candidate_volts.value: "volts_ledger"."candidate_volts" IS NULL OR (typeof("volts_ledger"."candidate_volts") = 'integer' AND "volts_ledger"."candidate_volts" BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991)

volts_ledger_cumulative_volts.name: volts_ledger_cumulative_volts
volts_ledger_cumulative_volts.value: ("volts_ledger"."cumulative_work_volts" IS NULL AND "volts_ledger"."cumulative_climb_volts" IS NULL) OR (typeof("volts_ledger"."cumulative_work_volts") = 'integer' AND "volts_ledger"."cumulative_work_volts" BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991 AND typeof("volts_ledger"."cumulative_climb_volts") = 'integer' AND "volts_ledger"."cumulative_climb_volts" BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991)
